{{Vanilla}}

{{Infobox auto}}

'''Popped chorus fruit''' is the simple preparation of [[Chorus Fruit|chorus fruit]]. It heals {{Value|Popped Chorus Fruit|heals}} and grants {{EffectLink|Levitation}} {{Value|Popped Chorus Fruit|level|effect=Levitation}} for {{Value|Popped Chorus Fruit|duration|effect=Levitation}}.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/food/oven/popped_chorus_fruit.json}}</ref>

== Obtaining ==

=== Cooking ===
{{Recipes}}
Chorus fruit pops in an [[oven]] or on [[kindling]] ({{Value|Popped Chorus Fruit|cook_time|station=Oven}}). Picking up chorus fruit unlocks the oven recipe.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/advancement/recipe_unlocks/chorus_fruit.json}}</ref>

== Usage ==

=== Food ===
Eating popped chorus fruit takes {{Value|Popped Chorus Fruit|eat_time}}, heals {{Value|Popped Chorus Fruit|heals}} and gives Levitation {{Value|Popped Chorus Fruit|level|effect=Levitation}} for {{Value|Popped Chorus Fruit|duration|effect=Levitation|format=clock}}.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/food/oven/popped_chorus_fruit.json}}</ref> Unlike raw chorus fruit it doesn't teleport.

Popped chorus fruit is used in [[Chorus Mochi|chorus mochi]] and, as in vanilla, purpur blocks.
